title: Shadow's FPS client Pack
description: A simple FPS boost modpack that improves Minecraft performance, increases frame rates, reduces lag, and speeds up loading times while keeping the vanilla gameplay experience unchanged.
body:
⚡ Ultimate FPS Boost Modpack ⚡

Tired of low FPS and lag ruining your gameplay? This modpack is designed to deliver a smooth, high-performance Minecraft experience without compromising the core feel of the game.

Packed with carefully selected optimization and performance-enhancing mods, this modpack significantly improves FPS, reduces stuttering, and speeds up loading times. Whether you're playing on a low-end PC or just want maximum performance, this pack ensures a stable and lag-free experience.

🚀 Features:
* Massive FPS boost and smoother gameplay
* Reduced lag spikes and faster world loading
* Optimized graphics and memory usage
* Compatible with most systems (low-end to high-end)
* Clean and lightweight – no unnecessary mods
🎮 Perfect For:
* PvP players who need consistent high FPS
* Players with low-end PCs or laptops
* Anyone who wants a smoother Minecraft experience

Enjoy Minecraft the way it should be played — fast, fluid, and lag-free.
